jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: Two IV heparin infusions where the older record holds the later stop (5h before the case) produced the Check PTT alert naming that stop time, with HEPARIN_STOPPED_RECENTLY set.
Negative: With the older record stopped 8h before the case and the newer record stopped 22h before, no alert fired and the rule abstained as patient no longer on heparin.
Red check: Swapping the pre-fix IInfusionMedicationAdministration class into the running container flipped both outcomes (positive abstained, negative alerted), and restoring the shipped class brought the alert back.

Automation: Unit coverage landed with the fix; a qa-suite positive/negative pair for a-preop-ptt and a unit test for the inverse case are proposed.
